meta.name: Bomber
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 3.32 KB

Bomber has you catching falling bombs before they hit the ground and blow everything apart. Each round grows faster and more unpredictable, pushing you to dart back and forth without missing a single drop. The gritty title screen also hints at the word's second meaning – you're not just chasing explosives, but a bit of street-sprayer attitude as well.

meta.name: Space Invaders
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.44 KB

This conversion of Space Invaders stays very true to the original despite being written in BASIC. Game play is exactly the same with the player in control of a tank at the bottom of the screen firing at advancing aliens. The aliens fire back and the player can take cover behind bunkers. The bunkers give way a little bit easier than in the arcade version due to fewer pixels. The sound also tries to stay true to the original with the ever increasing speed of the beat when the aliens draw nearer.

meta.name: Space War
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 2.67 KB

In Space War you control a spaceship at the bottom of the screen and defend yourself against attacking UFOs. The enemies appear above and move across the screen while trying to hit you. Using your laser you shoot the alien ships to destroy them and earn points. Missed shots or enemies that slip through are counted, so you must eliminate as many attackers as possible before they become overwhelming. The gameplay follows the classic Space Invaders style and requires quick reflexes and good timing.

meta.name: Star Wars
meta.desc:
⬇ Tamaño de descarga: 4.02 KB

Star Wars brings the arcade classic to the C64, letting you relive the film's most iconic moments. Across three stages that repeat with increasing difficulty, you first battle in space, then fight your way across the Death Star's surface, and finally attempt the legendary trench run. The goal is to endure as long as possible, because once your shield energy is depleted, the game is over.
